data.name: Error_tags_unsupported_version
data.value: The file's tags use an old format that CrateEdit cannot edit safely. The file was not changed.
data.comment: Error tags.unsupported-version.

data.name: Error_tags_unsupported_feature
data.value: The file's tags use a feature that CrateEdit does not support. The file was not changed.
data.comment: Error tags.unsupported-feature.

data.name: Error_tags_malformed
data.value: The file's tags are damaged or in an unexpected format. The file was not changed.
data.comment: Error tags.malformed.

data.name: Error_tags_encoded_frame
data.value: CrateEdit cannot change the {0} of this file because it is stored in a special format that CrateEdit cannot edit safely. The file was not changed.
data.comment: Error tags.encoded-frame. {0} is the field name as shown in the table, e.g. Artist.

data.name: Error_tags_duplicate_frame
data.value: This file contains the {0} twice, so it is unclear which one other programs show. CrateEdit did not change the file.
data.comment: Error tags.duplicate-frame. {0} is the field name as shown in the table, e.g. Artist.

data.name: Error_Unknown
data.comment: Fallback for an error code without a message. {0} is the error code.

data.name: Error_files_locked
data.value: The file is open in another program, so CrateEdit could not save it. Close the file in the other program and try again. The file was not changed.
data.comment: Error files.locked.

data.name: Error_files_access_denied
data.value: CrateEdit is not allowed to change this file. Check that it is not read-only and that you have permission to change it. The file was not changed.
data.comment: Error files.access-denied.

data.name: Error_files_not_found
data.value: The file could not be found. It may have been moved or deleted, or its drive may be disconnected.
data.comment: Error files.not-found.

data.name: Error_files_disk_full
data.value: The drive is full, so CrateEdit could not save the file. Free up some space and try again. The file was not changed.
data.comment: Error files.disk-full.

data.name: Error_files_verification_failed
data.value: CrateEdit checked the saved file and found a problem, so it kept the original. The file was not changed.
data.comment: Error files.verification-failed.

data.name: Error_files_io_error
data.value: The file could not be read or written. Check that its drive is connected and try again.
data.comment: Error files.io-error.
